method: Selected committed existing-registry entries, packet_tools target_control/run_targets/target_outcome or run_case/observation/execution_outcome. No alternate registry.
reproduction: Select the committed mutations.json cases whose IDs are absent at 95c395617cf5f266f3a6bd35bd20eba82e781671, retain registry order, and run each control plus each mutant using packet_tools. This full pass uses the existing registry. Clone with --no-local and npm ci first. The normal mutations operation runs these entries along with the prior corpus.
preflight: A first launcher import wrote its own __pycache__, and pristine refused before any case ran. Removed only that generated cache, then invoked Python with -B. No adoption attempt occurred in the refused launcher.
